attchmntText: Cura Technologies Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Cura Technologies Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss of 17.65 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of 1.38 lakh rupees in the same period last year. Earnings per share stood at minus 0.18 rupees. The Board also accepted the resignation of M/s. Aakanksha Dubey & Co. as Secretarial Auditor effective November 12, 2026. M/s. Manoj Parakh & Associates were appointed as the new Secretarial Auditor for the financial years 2026-27 and 2027-28. The appointment is effective from November 12, 2026.
